summary.intent: Plan, execute, and ship phase 63 (Read-Chain Navigation and Rotation Core) of CipherBox autonomously while the user was AFK, covering the full GSD pipeline: research → pattern-mapping → planning → verification → execution → ship.
summary.outcome: Planning was fully completed and verified (7 plans across 4 waves, 7/7 requirements + 10/10 decisions covered, plan-checker passed on iteration 2). Execution began with Wave 1, plan 63-01 dispatched at transcript end; execution and /ship-phase were not yet complete.

repo: Phase 63 builds a read-chain navigation walker, grant/invite crypto, and a rotation engine with 4 named seams explicitly reserved for Phase 64.
The GSD commit helper consistently produces false-negatives (reports failure) but commits land correctly; verified via git log — this happened on at least 3 commits (855ce39f3, 2c9ef1859, f8be4477c).
The API runs on port 3000 with a /health endpoint; CI polls it with `curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/health` in a bounded loop — the canonical pattern to replace fragile `sleep N` waits.
Commit signing was already disabled repo-locally (`commit.gpgsign: false`), so no biometric prompts block unattended runs.

The planner explicitly recommended sequential in-context execution over worktrees due to shared `folder.test.ts` coupling between plans 63-01 and 63-04 and known worktree pitfalls (node_modules, api:generate leaks) documented in project memory.
The `.planning/codebase/` map was stale (flagged by drift gate) but is non-blocking at plan time when CONTEXT.md and RESEARCH.md carry verified current implementation-site references.
API-SURFACE regenerated as empty (0 symbols) for sdk-core backend-only phases — expected, not an error.
UI gate check uses `frontend: false` in config to skip entirely for backend-only phases.

code.finding: Had a fragile `sleep 12` for API startup; replaced with a bounded health-poll loop mirroring the CI pattern (`curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/health`).
Open Questions section required explicit `(RESOLVED)` markers on answered questions to pass the plan-checker blocker — purely formatting, substantive answers were already present.

Nyquist VALIDATION.md body (per-task verification map + `nyquist_compliant: true`) must be filled during planning step 5.5, not left as template — leaving it as template triggers a plan-checker warning.

workflow: GSD plan-phase iteration loop: when plan-checker returns only formatting/tracking issues (not design flaws), fix them directly and re-spawn the checker as an independent subagent rather than re-spawning the planner — dramatically cheaper.
Pattern mapper produces PATTERNS.md with implementation analogs; 10 analogs were found for this phase and the file must be committed alongside plans.

Pre-execution gates for execute-phase: execute:pre hooks, safe-resume (no partial commits), no `.continue-here.md`, sync chain flag, branch verification, and STATE.md phase-start mark — all must pass before Wave 1 dispatches.
When already on the phase feature branch (planning commits present), execute-phase must reuse that branch and must NOT re-fork off main.

friction: GSD commit helper false-negatives on every commit required manual git log verification to confirm commits landed — occurred at least 3 times during planning alone.

Plan-checker required a second iteration due to 1 blocker and 2 warnings that were all trivial artifact issues (formatting, template not filled, fragile sleep), not plan-design problems — the independent re-spawn was correct but added latency.
63-07-PLAN.md could not be edited without a prior Read call, causing an extra round-trip to locate the exact sleep line before patching.
RESEARCH.md required multiple reads to locate the Open Questions section precisely enough to make the edit.
open_items: Wave 1 plan 63-01 execution was just dispatched at transcript end — Waves 1 (63-02, 63-03), 2, 3, and 4 remain unexecuted.
/ship-phase 63 (PR creation + review) has not been run yet.
Stale `.planning/codebase/` map was deferred as non-blocking at plan time but should be refreshed before or during Phase 64 planning.
Phase 64 has 4 named seams created by the rotation engine in plan 63-03 that will need to be wired up when Phase 64 is planned.
